Use only real capabilities, exact ports and IDs supplied below. Do not expand the requested scope. Do not simulate unsupported capabilities silently: report capability gaps. For a parameter-only request use setNodeParameter only; never duplicate effects. Flow noise has no exact native capability; explicitly warn that organicTexture is an animated sinusoidal approximation, never claim physical fluid noise. An accepted approximation can reuse the verified organicTexture package as a separate branch and blend via merge; never replace the requested gradient with an unrelated texture.
